themeVerdicts.explanation: The source identifies ZSL London Zoo as a public zoological garden opened in 1828 in Regent's Park and still operating at that London site.
Dublin Zoo is an individually named public zoo opened in 1831 in Phoenix Park and remains an operating animal-display institution at the site in Dublin.
The Ménagerie is a named menagerie principally displaying living animals, formally established in 1794, located within Paris's Jardin des Plantes, and still operating with public access.
Tiergarten Schönbrunn is a named zoo founded in 1752 in Vienna's Schönbrunn grounds and is identified as continuously operating as a public zoo.
ZOO Antwerpen is an individually named urban zoological garden established in 1843 beside Antwerpen-Centraal and still operating with living-animal exhibits and public visitation.
The Berlin Zoological Garden opened in 1844 at its Zoological Garden site in Berlin and remains a public zoo and city attraction.
ARTIS/Natura Artis Magistra is a named zoo founded in 1838 on its Amsterdam property, still operating publicly and displaying live animals despite also containing botanical and museum facilities.
Copenhagen Zoo is an individually named public zoological garden founded in 1859 and still operating at Frederiksberg in the Copenhagen urban area.
Moscow Zoo was founded in 1864, is located on its historic central Moscow site, and continues to display living animals to ordinary visitors.
Leningrad Zoo, now in Saint Petersburg, was founded in 1865 and remains a regularly visited public zoo at its historic location.
Wrocław Zoo is a named zoological garden opened in 1865 within Wrocław and continues operating as a public animal collection.
Budapest Zoo and Botanical Garden opened in 1866 in Budapest's City Park and remains a public institution displaying living animals at that site.
Zoo Basel is a named nonprofit zoo opened in 1874 at its urban Basel site and continues receiving regular public visitors.
Cologne Zoological Garden was founded in 1860 and remains an open, public zoological garden in Cologne.
Leipzig Zoological Garden was founded in 1878 and continues as a public zoo at its Leipzig site.
Dresden Zoo was founded in 1861 in the city's Großer Garten area and remains an operating public zoo displaying living animals.
Korkeasaari Zoo opened in 1889 on its Helsinki island site and remains a nonprofit public zoo with living-animal collections and visitor access.
Melbourne Zoo opened in 1862 at Royal Park in Melbourne and continues operating as a major public zoological garden at that site.
Adelaide Zoo opened in 1883 and remains a regularly open public zoo displaying living animals at its Adelaide site.
Alipore Zoological Gardens opened to the public in 1876 and remains an operating public zoo in Kolkata.

clueVerdicts.explanation: Its Revolutionary origin, transfer of a dissolved royal animal collection, and place within a national natural-history garden identify the Ménagerie du Jardin des Plantes.
The nature society that expanded into a zoo, aquarium, planetarium, arboretum, and botanical collection among historic buildings identifies ARTIS.
The late-nineteenth-century island setting, bridge access, northern-species conservation, and wildlife hospital identify Korkeasaari Zoo.
The founding collection donated by an older capital-city zoo, historic park setting, and low-cost Sunday admission identify Dublin Zoo without relying on exact counts.
The railway-station setting, Egyptian-style historic temple, and pioneering care of okapis identify ZOO Antwerpen without requiring exact dates.
